I need your help. What we found at the vet clinic and the x-ray office was not enough. Our next target is pharmacies. There were plenty of them around the city, so I don't think the thieves had time to take everything. Check out the pharmacies for me, then I'll send my men over. I know of at least three. See what condition they're in.}} ==Objectives== *Locate the first pharmacy on Primorsky Ave on [[Streets of Tarkov]] *Locate the second pharmacy on Primorsky Ave on [[Streets of Tarkov]] *Locate the third pharmacy at Cardinal apartment complex on [[Streets of Tarkov]] *Survive and extract from the location ==Rewards== *+9,000 [[EXP]] *[[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.02''' *55,000 Roubles **57,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 **63,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 *4× [[Disposable syringe]] *4× [[Pile of meds]] *2× [[Morphine injector]] *2× [[L1 (Norepinephrine) injector]] {{quote|Most of them looted, too? I'm not surprised at all, but it's still better than nothing at all.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to locate three pharmacies on [[Streets of Tarkov]]. All three pharmacies must be found in a single raid. If you leave the raid and have only found some of the pharmacies, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found all the pharmacies.
